summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing an appraisal report on the net book value of JUNO Participações e Investimentos S.A. as of June 10, 2026, prepared by TATICCA Auditores e Consultores Ltda. The report is for a proposed merger of Juno into AXIA, to be submitted for shareholder approval. No acquisition price, premium, or deal terms are disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report providing an accounting valuation. No special-situation event or transaction terms are announced. This is a procedural step in a statutory merger, not a formal acquisition announcement. Watch for shareholder vote and merger completion timeline.
